zeroModelProbeDesign.purpose: Prove, without a model call, that a managed worker Session is actually mounted with the restricted task slot plus exactly the two trusted event tools, that event tool parameters cannot carry authority, and that the probe/release path leaves no business or inference residue.

entrypoints.workerDriver: WorkerSessionDriver.probeEventTools(options) in src/adapters/dsh/workers.ts; dedicated disposable Session id shiyu-worker-probe-<uuid> with WORKER_PRESET_ID and an absolute cwd.
entrypoints.runtimeCommand: POST /api/shiyu/commands { action: 'runtime.probe-event-tools' } -> RuntimeService.commandEventToolProbe; receipt cached read-only under snapshot().diagnostics.eventToolProbe; zeroModel/readOnly/sent fields make the guarantee explicit.

zeroModelProbeDesign.constructionPath: Same mountRestrictedSurface helper as a real run: native tool presentation, deny every inherited host tool, fixed worker system-prompt section, registered placeholder task tool (shiyu_worker_probe_task) plus the attached event tools, and tool schemas assembled only from the trusted declarations. No followup, no model request, no business Task/binding/event. cancel+dispose in finally; late handles after abort are disposed; assembly/authority/model-activity/cleanup failures reject explicitly and are never retried.
checks: assembled tool names exactly equal assignment placeholder + 2 event tools; host tools (shell/read_file/network/run_code/...) never survive; duplicate names impossible at driver layer

authority scan over every declared parameter property name (actor/permit/scope/taskId/assignmentId/principalId/hostEpoch/installationGeneration/fencingToken/leaseExpiresAt/authorization/ownerId/grant/mandate/verification/accounting/budget/...)
model activity detection via session/event, agent/request and llm/stream; counters must stay all 0
release/dispose must complete; creation failure, malformed source, source without tools, authority fields, model activity, abort-late handle and disposal failure are all explicit failures
receipt is read-only diagnostics: no accepted Event, no Task/Goal/Lab side effect; repeated calls may probe again but accumulate no business state
zeroModelProbeDesign.admissionSemantics: Same class as the existing session.probe: unavailable while globally paused, consumes one shared runtime operation slot (capacity 2), abortable, no retries. This is documented rather than inventing a pause exception.

offlineTests.invariants: core decision remains zero-tool/single-request and replyer remains zero-tool: neither adapter was edited; the H1 core-goal-sessions and replyer isolation tests are part of the same isolated full check.

zeroModelProbeDesign.boundaries: Offline synthetic native protocol only in this batch. On the fixed host the Lead invokes the command during the joint reload. The probe proves mount + restrictions + release, not that a real model actually called the tool, provider budgets, or continuation dispatch (G4 and H2c remain future gaps).
